question: Should OpenClaw own static Codex price snapshots in the fallback catalog, or should this PR only recompute Codex zero cost from operator-configured positive pricing?
rationale: AGENTS.md treats provider defaults and config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive, and upstream Codex exposes token counts rather than authoritative costs, so static pricing ownership is a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Keep Configured Pricing Only
options.body: Remove the static Codex price table and fallback model addition while preserving the resolver behavior for configured positive pricing.

options.title: Accept Static Codex Defaults
options.body: Land static Codex prices after maintainers explicitly own their accuracy and update cadence.

options.title: Split The Work
options.body: Land the zero-cost resolver repair now and track Codex fallback pricing defaults in a separate maintainer-owned PR or issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Configured Pricing Only
recommendation.body: Remove the static Codex price table and fallback model addition while preserving the resolver behavior for configured positive pricing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent OpenAI/Codex provider identity and zero-rate usage-cost history most directly tied to this decision.
